text: Here is how an Eternalgy solar proposal looks on your phone. Everything your customer needs, in one link.
Swipe up to move through the proposal. Each slide covers one part of the system, from the roof survey right through to the final savings.
The panel specification is called out clearly, so your customer can see exactly which hardware they are paying for.
The scope of works lists every item included in the package, including the T N B application and the roof survey.
And the guarantee closes it out. Three years workmanship, one year roof leak. Send the link, and your customer has the whole story.
